examples.text: ProdCo represents and warrants to Amazon that ProdCo has the full right, power, and authority to enter into this Agreement and to grant all rights granted herein, free and clear of any liens, claims, or encumbrances.
triggers_found: free and clear of any liens

examples.text: The Program and Materials will be wholly original with ProdCo or properly licensed, and will not infringe upon or violate any copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, right of privacy, right of publicity, or any other right of any third party.
ProdCo represents that the Program and Materials will not contain any defamatory, libelous, or unlawful content, and will not violate any applicable law, regulation, or court order.
ProdCo warrants that there is no claim, litigation, or proceeding pending or threatened that would adversely affect ProdCo's ability to perform its obligations or Amazon's rights hereunder.
triggers_found: no claim, litigation, or proceeding pending

examples.text: ProdCo represents and warrants that all persons rendering services in connection with the Program have executed or will execute appropriate agreements assigning all rights to ProdCo or Amazon and containing confidentiality provisions consistent with this Agreement.
ProdCo represents that ProdCo and all Key Persons are in compliance with all applicable laws regarding anti-corruption, anti-bribery, sanctions, and export controls.
ProdCo represents and warrants that all factual representations made regarding the Program, including its premise, characters, and storylines, are accurate and not misleading.

ProdCo hereby represents that it is duly organized, validly existing, and in good standing under the laws of its jurisdiction of organization, and has all requisite corporate power to conduct its business.

negative_examples.text: The representations and warranties set forth in this Article 5 shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement in perpetuity.
negative_examples.why_not_reps: This is a survival provision about reps, not the reps themselves

negative_examples.text: Any breach of ProdCo's representations shall entitle Amazon to terminate and seek indemnification.
